These '''ancient texts''' were kept in the box in [[Yoda's Hut/Legends|Yoda's hut]], alongside keepsakes and [[Yoda's lightsaber/Legends|Yoda's lightsaber]], on the [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] world of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. During the 22 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] he spent on self-imposed exile on Dagobah, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] has been able to devote much of his time to deciphering these texts.<ref name="ITW" /><ref name="CL" />
